## Description

Provide a summary of the changes proposed in this pull request and the issue it addresses.

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat:` New feature
- [ ] `fix:` Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor:` Code refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] `test:` Adding or updating tests
- [ ] `docs:` Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My PR targets the **`dev`** branch.
- [ ] My commit messages follow the Conventional Commits format (e.g. `feat: ...`, `fix: ...`).
- [ ] I followed the Test-Driven Development (TDD) cycle and added tests covering my changes.
- [ ] All tests pass locally via `make test` or `ctest`.
- [ ] I reviewed existing ADRs in `docs/adr/`, and proposed a new ADR if a new tool or architecture change was introduced.
